results.acceptance: The CLI exports a new ZIP containing the unchanged C04 v1 manifest and its three referenced synthetic files. bundle.ReadArchive accepts the reopened ZIP with verification unverified and rejects modified or absent archive members with typed errors.
results.negative_cases: Build rejects changed or missing source files, malformed or unsupported manifests, over-limit input, a reserved manifest member, and an outside-root symlink. A shell-script sentinel remains inert. Existing output is not overwritten, and missing source publishes no output; mixed CLI modes fail. A second CLI process retains the original passport export behavior.
results.security: os.Root confines file reads; bounded sizes, SHA-256 and the existing C09 archive reader validate ZIP bytes before a temporary output file is linked to a previously absent target. No schema, service API, protected file or dependency changed.
results.regression: All Go packages and all 28 Node tests passed locally. No remote CI or full C30 workflow was run.
